contexts.text: He inflicted pain on... the toes of the left foot. SE 3371.
This is the finger of God () = that the power was from the Divine... That a finger = power. Illustrated. AC 7430:2. AC 10062:5, Illustrated. AE 329:27.
Thou shalt put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger () = the Divine power of the Lord from proprium... Finger = power.
As ultimates = the whole... so do the toes and the fingers.
They wind them with their toes.
Tables of stone written with the finger of God () = Divine truth there from the Lord Himself.
A Spirit in Hell dare not put forth a finger. AR 339:2.
The Angels begin (the examination) at the fingers.
God perpetually holds with His finger...
Their fingers were intensely black and devoid of flesh, like the claws of a scorpion.
As when the digits of the foot or hand are congealed by cold...
The Divine omnipotence which is meant by the finger of God...
